verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo states that an "open-source branch" of Reader exists and ships as a prebuilt container image, so source is publicly readable. The evidence never names the license, and it implies only a branch is open while SaaS features such as the hosted proxy pool are not. Missing for 10: the specific open license (e.g. Apache-2.0/MIT) is undocumented, it is unclear whether the open branch matches the hosted service, and there is no independent corroboration of source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: A prebuilt image of the open-source branch is published to GitHub Container Registry.
